title: 第82章 回家过年

第82章 回家过年-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

大年二十八，一大早，吴姜就和王大雷给墨香居贴上对联，今天就算正式歇业了。

王大雷脸上满是喜气洋洋的神色，嘴角就没合上过。

也不怪他高兴，今年的年终奖，给他换成了王雅琴替换下来的那辆X3，能不高兴吗？

王雅琴的那辆车才开了没几年，行驶里程还不到三万公里，车况极好，里外都跟新的一样，就算是卖二手车，也能卖个不错的价钱，够他回老家装逼的了。

王大雷跟着吴时安多年，一直任劳任怨，踏实肯干，还是吴姜的救命恩人，所以，吴时安一家对他一向不小气，平时待他就像家人一样。

贴完春联，吴姜和王大雷互相说了几句吉祥话，王大雷就先走了，吴姜则转身去了隔壁。

李文博也准备今天关店，店里的伙计张军正在收拾东西，吴姜帮着一起，把墨韵轩的春联也贴好，这才去和老爹老妈汇合。

吴时安他们已经收拾好了，看到吴姜的车过来，就一起往苍名县驶去。

路上恰逢返程高峰，堵了好一阵子车，等吴姜他们驶下高速，已经快下午一点了。

还没到小区门口，，吴姜就隔着车窗远远瞥见老爷子，站在小区大门旁，翘首以盼。

一看到吴姜他们的车缓缓驶来，老爷子脸上的皱纹瞬间舒展开，脸上挂满了笑容。

“爷爷，这么大风，您怎么不在家里等着，冻着可怎么办！”

吴姜的车在前面，停好以后，就快步下车，一把搀扶住老爷子的胳膊，语气里满是埋怨。

“呵呵，我在家待着也没事，就下来等你们了。”老爷子笑呵呵的说道。

吴时安也将车停好了，和王雅琴一起下车，凑到老爷子跟前，语气带着几分无奈：“爸，您这也太见外了，我们又不是不认路，哪用得着您亲自下来接啊。”

老爷子转头看向儿子，脸上的笑容瞬间收敛，语气毫不客气地怼了回去：“滚犊子！你小子少往自己脸上贴金，谁稀罕接你？我是来等我孙儿和儿媳妇的！”

Chapter 82 Going home for the New Year - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out I am the Nth generation of gods"

On New Year's Eve, early in the morning, Wu Jiang and Wang Dalei posted couplets on Moxiangju, and it was officially closed today.

Wang Dalei's face was full of joy, and the corners of his mouth never closed.

It’s no wonder that he is happy. This year’s year-end bonus is for him to get the X3 that Wang Yaqin replaced. Can he not be happy?

Wang Yaqin's car has only been driven for a few years and has a mileage of less than 30,000 kilometers. The car is in excellent condition and is like new inside and out. Even if it is a second-hand car, it can be sold for a good price, which is enough for him to show off when he returns to his hometown.

Wang Dalei has been with Wu Shi'an for many years. He has always worked hard and worked hard, and he is Wu Jiang's savior. Therefore, Wu Shi'an's family has never been stingy with him and treats him like a family member.

After posting the Spring Festival couplets, Wu Jiang and Wang Dalei said a few auspicious words to each other. Wang Dalei left first, while Wu Jiang turned around and went to the next door.

Li Wenbo was also preparing to close the store today. Zhang Jun, the clerk in the store, was packing things. Wu Jiang helped him put up Mo Yunxuan's Spring Festival couplets, and then went to meet his parents.

Wu Shi'an and the others had already packed up. When they saw Wu Jiang's car approaching, they drove to Cangming County together.

The road coincided with the rush hour for the return trip, and there was a traffic jam for a while. By the time Wu Jiang and the others got off the expressway, it was almost one o'clock in the afternoon.

Before reaching the gate of the community, Wu Jiang caught a glimpse of the old man from a distance through the car window, standing by the gate of the community, looking forward to it.

As soon as he saw Wu Jiang's car approaching slowly, the wrinkles on the old man's face instantly relaxed, and his face was filled with a smile.

"Grandpa, it's so windy, why don't you wait at home? What will you do if it's freezing!"

Wu Jiang's car was in front. After parking, he quickly got out of the car and held the old man's arm, his tone full of complaints.

"Haha, I have nothing to do if I stay at home, so I will come down and wait for you." The old man said with a smile.

Wu Shi'an also parked the car, got out of the car with Wang Yaqin, and approached the old man. His tone was a little helpless: "Dad, you are too unfamiliar. It's not like we don't know the way, so there is no need for you to come down and pick him up in person."

The old man turned to look at his son, the smile on his face instantly faded, and he said back in an unceremonious tone: "Get out of here! Don't you try so hard on yourself, why would anyone want to pick you up? I'm here to wait for my grandson and daughter-in-law!"
